title: AI agents
switch: Let AI agents see your library
switchHint: Agent apps such as Claude Code and Claude Desktop can search your library and look at your assets while Mimikit is open. They can't change anything, and each app asks you first.
offNote: Turning this off forgets the apps you allowed.
claudeCode: Claude Code: run this once in a terminal.
claudeDesktop: Claude Desktop: add this to claude_desktop_config.json (Settings › Developer › Edit Config), then restart Claude Desktop.
other: Other agent apps: start this program with the argument mcp, as a stdio MCP server.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
none: None yet. Once an agent app is set up, ask it something like “find a coin sprite in Mimikit”.
paused: Paused: its calls are refused until you resume.
allowedHint: Their new sessions connect without asking.
askBody: It can search your library, read its file names, folders, tags and notes, and look at your assets. It can't change anything. You can disconnect it at any time in Settings › AI agents.
